stories.label: Iran war Day 23: Migrant workers as hidden casualties, OIC silence
stories.summary: Day 23: War's invisible toll extends to millions of Gulf migrant workers with no evacuation — Nepali guard killed in Abu Dhabi. Muslim world's institutional silence exposed as Pakistan's PTI demands OIC emergency session. War continues across military, economic, diplomatic, and human dimensions.

stories.label: Hormuz crisis: Australia considering fuel rationing, EU reverses on nuclear
stories.summary: Economic fallout reaching allied consumer nations: Australia discussing fuel rationing (holds only ~20 days reserves), EU chief calls nuclear phase-out a 'strategic mistake.' IEA reserves activated but Global South still unprotected.

stories.label: Lebanon: 850,000+ displaced, systematic destruction of medical infrastructure
stories.summary: Lebanon humanitarian catastrophe: 850,000 displaced in 10 days, 38+ medics killed. Not covered this cycle — watch for UN session on humanitarian corridors.
